No finite calculation is used to prove an infinite claim.

value.rationale: Repeat avoidance is a natural constrained coding alphabet, while a contiguous two-symbol corruption is a motivated burst channel distinct from conventional Hamming errors. The exact eight-message length threshold, tight upper-bound mechanism, and constructive matching capacities at short lengths give useful finite code design and benchmarking information not implied by general coding bounds. No unmotivated arbitrary slice or downstream claim is required for the exact finite threshold.
